summary: This week in AI news, significant developments include Anthropic's new watermarking system, OpenAI's Ultrafast mode, and NVIDIA's plan to make GPUs more valuable. Other notable stories cover AI applications in various industries, such as education and entertainment.
insight: The increasing focus on watermarking and identifying AI-generated content highlights the growing need for transparency and accountability in AI development and usage.
highlights: Anthropic introduces a new watermarking system to identify AI-generated content
OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode for its GPT-5.6 model, significantly improving performance
NVIDIA unveils a plan to maintain the value of its GPUs despite the rise of AI
